text:
Alex M.: Heads up — I'm assembling the internal release note + ops blurb for the Fri microdeploy. Need the canary plan and pin-check table.
Priya S.: Please call out model pin behavior explicitly. We had a stray pin flip last time. Note: model-pin map should remain stable during canary.
Tom B.: Rollout plan: canary -> 20% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> full. Total change window 60m. Target start: Fri 02:30 UTC (Thu 19:30 PT).
Elena G.: Also flag the embedding reindex task — it kicks off post-promote and runs ~18-25m depending on shard load. Customer-facing similarity endpoints might see degraded recall briefly.
Alex M.: Draft one-liner for review: "Microdeploy v2.4.0 (runtime & cache fixes) — rolling canary Fri 02:30 UTC. Expect brief embedding reindex during promote; ops monitoring in place."
Priya S.: Add short rollback rule: revert if 5m error rate > 1% OR sustained GPU mem growth > 20% over baseline for 10m.
Tom B.: Rollback CLI snippet to include in notes:
```
/deploy canary v2.4.0 --region=us-west-2 --steps=20,50,100 --watch
/deploy rollback v2.4.0 v2.3.9 --reason="ops-threshold"
```
deploy-bot: canary request queued by Alex M. — see /deploy status 1705009999 for live progress.
sre-oncall-bot: monitors to observe: 500s rate, P95 latency, GPU memory, embedding-job duration. Alerts wired to #sre-oncall and pager if thresholds breach.
Elena G.: For the internal blast, include two quick bullets: what users might notice + immediate contact points (sre-oncall, support-lead). I'll add the short customer advisory copy for Support.
Alex M.: Where to host the pin-check table after dry-run? Prefer wiki link.
Priya S.: Use: https://wiki.redwood/internal/pinchecks/v2.4.0-dryrun (create after dry-run).
Tom B.: Canary playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/canary-playbook — include that link and the evacuation runbook as well.
Alex M.: Short rollback checklist for ops in the note: - run `/deploy rollback v2.4.0 v2.3.9` - disable canary routing - post status in #incident-announce - contact support@redwood. Keep it minimal.
Elena G.: I'll run the pin dry-run Wed 16:00 UTC and paste the table here. If any mismatch, we'll push deploy by 24h.
Priya S.: Also include: if any pinned model reference is overridden, tag infra@redwood immediately.
deploy-bot: reminder: ensure deploy is executed from ops CI with `--watch` flag to enable automatic rollback triggers.
sre-oncall-bot: collision check passed for target window — no other maintenance scheduled.
Alex M.: Thanks — please sign off by Thu 22:00 UTC. I'll merge notes and hand to Elena for the internal broadcast. :thumbsup:
